title: Som Distilleries jumps on MP licence ruling

timeline.title: Som Distilleries jumps on MP licence ruling
timeline.line: MP High Court quashed the rejection of its 2026-27 excise licences; renewal due in 15 days
more: The court also awarded ₹1 lakh in costs to the company
